notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped default-region attribute alternate-advance surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies supplied-empty source-region metadata and timestamped Update/Reflect delivery through Flush Queue Request, Time Advance Request Available, and Next Message Request Available, including grant/query bounds and cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped default-region attribute delivery through alternate advances with FederateAmbassador reflection and grant callbacks
